reuse.why: Keeps the rule in the existing getScheduledAmount helper and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the approximate tolerance; the API field calls the same helper.

duplication.why: No logic is copied: every expected-amount consumer, including the new API field, goes through the one helper.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the API mapping in api-models scheduleModel, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on the rule, its callers and the API field, with one unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: Simplifies the helper by dropping the rounding variant, but the new op argument is optional and positional behind a boolean, so callers can silently omit it (several UI callers do).

bypasses_abstraction.where: none: all changed sites call getScheduledAmount

abstraction_drift.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount: the rangeRounding option is replaced by an optional op parameter and an isapprox branch; this is the rule's real variation rather than accumulated special cases, though optional op lets some UI callers (SchedulesTable, mobile list, useScheduleEdit) omit it
